title: My laptop is so slow
picker_summary: Second-week hire’s laptop crawls when he opens anything.

caller.name: Lucas
caller.mood: Easygoing, a bit embarrassed to call about something small.
caller.opening_line: Hey, this is probably nothing, but my laptop has gotten really slow. Opening anything takes forever.

hidden.cause: Three things at once: he hasn't restarted in about three weeks (he just closes the lid), his browser has about 40 tabs eating memory, and his disk is nearly full from onboarding videos in Downloads.

facts.fact: Laptop has been slow for a few days, worst when opening apps.
He never shuts down. He just closes the lid at night.
facts.reveal_when: asked when he last restarted or shut down

facts.fact: He keeps a lot of browser tabs open, maybe 40.
facts.reveal_when: asked what he has open or what he's running

facts.fact: He downloaded all the onboarding videos to watch offline.
facts.reveal_when: asked about downloads, big files, or storage

facts.fact: The fan runs loud a lot.
facts.reveal_when: asked about noise, heat, or the fan

facts.fact: The restart takes a while. Afterwards it's noticeably faster, but big files still open slowly.
Task Manager shows memory at 94%, almost all of it his browser. Closing most of the tabs frees it up.
facts.reveal_when: the technician walks him through opening Task Manager and asks what he sees

facts.fact: His C: drive has 4 GB free out of 256 GB. Downloads holds about 60 GB of onboarding videos he's already watched. He only deletes them if the technician says it's OK.
facts.reveal_when: the technician has him check storage, the C: drive, or the Downloads folder

facts.fact: Once he has restarted, closed the extra tabs, and cleared the videos, the laptop feels fast again.
facts.reveal_when: he has done all three of those steps

solution.diagnosis: Weeks without a restart, a memory-heavy browser, and a nearly full disk. Fixed on the call by talking him through a restart, Task Manager, and freeing disk space with his OK. There's no console action for this; it's all guidance.

escalate_network.why: Nothing points to the network, and L1 can fix this on the call.
escalate_network.caller_reaction: He's told someone else will look at it. The laptop is still slow.

admin_password_reset.why: Has nothing to do with performance.
admin_password_reset.caller_reaction: He has to change his password. The laptop is still slow.

solution.on_unlisted_action: Nothing changes. The laptop is still slow.

diagnosis.check: Asks what's slow and when it started
Finds out when he last restarted
Checks what's using memory with Task Manager
Fixes it on the call instead of escalating

verification.check: Checks after each step whether it helped before moving on
Gets his OK before deleting files and checks they aren't needed for work

communication.check: Gives one clear step at a time in plain words
Explains the cause: no restart in weeks, too many tabs, a full disk
Gives prevention tips, like restarting weekly and clearing Downloads
Confirms it feels faster before closing

documentation.check: Notes record what was checked: restart history, memory, disk
Notes record the cause and what fixed it
Final status matches the expected status
